item.title: MD5 Encryption Explained: How MD5 Hashing Works and How to Decrypt It
item.description: If you have ever downloaded software, checked a file checksum, or stored a password in a database, you have probably met MD5, even if you did not notice it. MD5 is one of the oldest and most widely recognised hashing algorithms in computing, and it still appears in tutorials, legacy systems, and everyday developer tools. item.title: GlobeTopper faces up to $2.5 million in lost revenue after hackers steal $70,000 in gift cards
item.description: Hackers breached GlobeTopper, a B2B digital gift card and top-up platform, and stole API credentials belonging to some of its business customers, while gift cards worth about $70,000 were redeemed without authorization. According to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), parent company iQSTEL said GlobeTopper detected the intrusion on October 22 and took the platform offline the next morning after spotting further unauthorized activity.
